text: dsh-inbox 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的个人收件箱插件，可将复制的文字、链接、图片和文件收进本地 vault，并在侧边栏浏览。它通过面板、/inbox 命令和对话工具接收内容，按规则或有限的模型调用分类，支持关键词筛选、稍后阅读标记、编辑与恢复。适合希望集中保存并在对话中找回资料的 DSH 用户；可选配置 WebDAV 或 S3 同步。

dsh-inbox is a personal inbox plugin for DSH web. It saves copied text, links, images, and files in a local vault. Capture through the sidebar, /inbox command, or chat tools; classify, filter, edit, and retrieve records. Optional WebDAV or S3 settings enable syncing.
想把复制的链接和文字集中存进 DSH 的个人收件箱。
DSH 有没有地方能保存图片和文件，之后再翻出来？
帮我在聊天里搜一下之前收藏的那篇文章。
我希望能给保存的资料分类并加上稍后阅读标记。
如何把对话里需要留存的片段归档到本地？
让 DSH 能通过侧边栏查看和编辑我收集的内容。
I want to save copied links and snippets in one searchable inbox.
Can I find a file or image I saved earlier from a chat?
dsh-inbox 的收集功能：把文字、链接或附件存入 vault。可从侧边栏面板、/inbox 命令或对话工具提交；相同内容会合并到已有记录。
dsh-inbox 的自动分类功能：根据内容规则判定类别，规则无法确定时可请求 DSH 模型服务协助。分类结果写入记录，并受每日调用与 token 上限约束。
dsh-inbox 的对话检索功能：按文字、类别、稍后阅读标记、类型或标签筛选收件箱，最多返回十条匹配记录，再按 id 打开详情。
dsh-inbox 的侧边栏管理面板：浏览、筛选并查看记录详情，提供编辑、删除和恢复等交互；浏览器端通过插件声明的路由请求主机数据。
dsh-inbox 使用模型分类时会将待分类文本（先脱敏并截短）或待判别图片发给 DSH 当前配置的模型服务；规则已能判断的内容会跳过模型调用。
dsh-inbox 的 WebDAV 或 S3 同步会连接用户配置的远端端点；只有配置同步后，记录才会在该远端与本地之间传输。
@chance722/dsh-inbox 提供工具 inbox_status：Report whether the dsh-inbox (the user's 收件箱 / 仓库 / inbox) is loaded, how many records it holds and whether it opened cleanly. Takes no arguments.

@chance722/dsh-inbox 提供工具 inbox_search：Search the user's personal dsh-inbox — their 收件箱, which they also call 仓库 / 个人仓库 / inbox. Returns at most ten matches with their ids, newest first; secrets are listed but their text is never returned.
@chance722/dsh-inbox 提供工具 inbox_get：Open one record by the id a search returned: text, link, note, tags and attachment facts; credentials are never returned in clear text.
@chance722/dsh-inbox 提供工具 inbox_put：File something into the user's dsh-inbox when they ask to keep it; a URL is filed as a link and other input as text.
@chance722/dsh-inbox 提供命令 inbox：收进仓库：把这段文字、链接或附件存进 dsh-inbox，不发给模型

@chance722/dsh-inbox README · What it is：The things you copy in a day — a link to read later, a screenshot, a config snippet, an account and password — end up scattered across clipboard history, bookmarks and temp files. dsh-inbox keeps them in one local vault: paste to file, automatic classification, browse and search from the sidebar — and instead of digging through it yourself, ask your assistant "what was that article about caching I saved last month?".
@chance722/dsh-inbox README · What it is：Everything lands on your machine, and the model only sees a record when you ask it to look.

@chance722/dsh-inbox README · Features：| Feature | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Three ways in** | `/inbox <text or link>` in the composer (attach images to carry them along), paste / drop / pick a file in the panel, or ask the assistant to keep something |
| **Automatic classification** | Links by platform and media type (60-odd sites: Bilibili, YouTube, WeChat, 掘金, Zhihu…), text by credential shape, images get a 疑似证件 tag at card proportions; the rest goes to the model, with a daily cap |
| **Panel** | Filter by watch-later / category / tag, search title, text, link and note, two list densities; the detail pane edits name, category, note and tags, flags watch-later, deletes and restores — and it follows dsh's theme **and language** |
| **Every record has a name** | A link takes the page's own headline (no model tokens), a photo or file its file name, and the name you type always wins. A page that will not be read — an anti-bot page, a dead link — leaves the address as the name rather than a guess |
| **Who judged the category** | A coloured badge: 规则判定 (local rules) / 模型判定 (the capped model pass) / 手动判定 (yours — nothing overwrites it later) |
| **Ask in conversation** | Ask for 收件箱

text:
@chance722/dsh-inbox README · Where things live：| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Records: text, links, category, note, tags, watch-later… | `storages\dsh_inbox\items\*.json`, one file each |
| Attachment index (mime / size / original name) | `storages\dsh_inbox\attachments\*.json` |
| The **bytes** of images, videos and files | `attachments\` — dsh's own content-addressed store, never auto-deleted |
| Remote password / S3 AccessKey Secret | dsh's credential store, `.credentials.yaml` |
| Remote settings (URL, bucket, client identity…) | dsh's own settings |

@chance722/dsh-inbox README · What the remote looks like：| Remote path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `inbox/<whatever you drop>` | The **drop folder**: any device drops files here and this one ingests them |
| `inbox/sync/items/<record id>.json` | One record, **machine-readable** — the source of truth for sync |
| `inbox/sync/items/<record id>.txt` | The same record, **readable** (text, note, which attachments it points at) |
| `inbox/sync/attachments/<attachment id>.<ext>` | Attachment **bytes** (images, video, PDFs open as themselves) |
| `inbox/sync/attachments/<attachment id>.meta.json` | The attachment's metadata (original name, dimensions, size, digest) |
| A 0-byte key ending in `/` | A folder marker the cloud drive made itself, not us |

@chance722/dsh-inbox README · How syncing works：- **Automatic**: a push seconds after a capture or edit (debounced — several quick saves are one push); 「同步」 is a full sync: push → pull → re-read the list.
- **Merging**: per `id` + timestamp, the newer write wins, no conflict copies; needed attachment bytes come down with the record.
- **Two machines**: one shared 「目录」 (blank, `/` and `inbox` are the same). Records a machine left under an older directory come back if you tick **Merge other sync directories too** in the settings.
- **Deleting**: 「删除」 only moves a record to the bin and the other devices are told it is gone; emptying the bin deletes the cloud copy as well, and it stays deleted — a copy sitting in another sync directory cannot file it back in.

@chance722/dsh-inbox README · Privacy and security：- **Credential bodies are encrypted at rest** (AES-256-GCM, key derived from your master password). Neither the password nor the key is written down: the vault locks on every restart and you unlock it under 设置 → 账密加密, and a forgotten password means unrecoverable ciphertext. With no master password set, a credential is **refused rather than stored in the clear**. **On a second machine**, synced credentials open with the master password you set on the first one — the derivation parameters travel, the password does not.
- **That covers the body only**: notes, categories, tags, timestamps and attachment **bytes** are not encrypted — a key inside a pasted file is still a key inside a file.
- **Masked where it matters**: a credential is listed by the name you gave it, and its plain text never reaches a conversation or a model.
- **Pictures**: classification does send an image to the model, and the conversation gets an `[attachment:id]` marker — that one image is sent only when you explicitly ask the assistant to look at it.
